title: Docker Container Testing Guide
titleEs: Guía de Testing de Contenedores Docker
description: Runnable companion for the Docker Container Testing Guide: a Compose test stack (postgres + app under test) with real healthchecks, depends_on service_healthy ordering, resource limits and a verification script that exercises the seven testing areas.
descriptionEs: Companion ejecutable de la Guía de Testing de Contenedores Docker: stack Compose (postgres + app bajo test) con healthchecks reales, orden depends_on service_healthy, límites de recursos y un script de verificación que ejercita las siete áreas de testing.
author: Mathias Paulenko
